address: 114 Mu 7, Ban Khok Klang, Chorakhe, Nong Ruea, Khon Kaen, 40240, Thailand
bio: Farm-to-table is the philosophy here. The owner grows fruits and vegetables and raises poultry on the farm. They use simple cooking techniques and focus on the ingredients' natural flavours. Although short, the menu perfectly embodies the Isan spirit. The standout dish is Isan thick curry with local fish, which has a tender and juicy texture. Diners can enjoy their meal in an open-air pavilion and even attend a culinary workshop to learn how to cook the signature dish....
